title: Stepwise Investigation of the Influences of Steric Groups versus Counterions To Target Cu/Dy Complexes

material_class.structural_family: Cu9Dy2 cluster from H3L3 (R = ethyl Schiff base); structure reported previously

synthesis.procedure: Prepared by the previously reported method using Dy(NO3)3·6H2O, CuBr2, and H3L3 (R = ethyl). The main text states that ligand syntheses and full reaction conditions are in the experimental section, which is supplied as Supporting Information, but gives no numerical amounts.

properties.summary: Previously published magnetic data are restated: dominant ferromagnetic interactions and a ferrimagnetic spin topology. AC susceptibility and Cole–Cole analysis indicate SMM behavior.

measurements.conditions: Arrhenius fit of AC susceptibility; R = 0.99

measurements.conditions: Arrhenius fit of AC susceptibility; R = 0.99

source_locations.location: Synthetic Strategy; Associated Content notes synthesis is in SI

material_class.structural_family: pentanuclear Cu3Dy2; monoclinic P2(1)/c, Z = 4; related to a published Cu3Ln2 core

synthesis.procedure: Obtained under conditions similar to complex 1, using Dy(NO3)3·6H2O, CuBr2, and H3L2 (R = methyl) instead of H3L3. Crystallized as a pentanuclear compound. Numerical reagent amounts are not given in the main text.

reagents.name: 2-methyl Schiff-base ligand from o-vanillin and a 2-amino-1,3-propanediol
reagents.amount: in situ solution from 0.25 mmol of each precursor in 10.0 mL methanol

synthesis.temperature: ligand reflux; complexation at room temperature
synthesis.time: ligand reflux 1 h; stirred 10 min; crystals after a few days
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: crystallized; lattice content 4 MeOH and one bromide

properties.summary: Room-temperature χMT matches three Cu(II) and two Dy(III). χMT falls on cooling, plateaus, then decreases slightly at the lowest temperature. Magnetization does not saturate, consistent with anisotropy and/or low-lying excited states. Field-dependent AC signals are observed, but an optimum DC field and an energy barrier were not established.

measurements.name: chiMT
measurements.conditions: room temperature, 1000 Oe; expected 29.5 cm3 K/mol

measurements.name: magnetization
measurements.conditions: 2.0 K, 7.0 T; no saturation; isotherms 2.0–5.0 K

source_locations.location: Synthesis of the Schiff Base Ligands H3L1–H3L3; Synthesis of Complex (2)

material_class.structural_family: Cu5Dy5; two nearly isostructural clusters in P-1, Z = 2; Dy4 tetrahedron about a μ4-oxide plus a fifth Dy

synthesis.procedure: Isolated from Dy(NO3)3·6H2O, CuBr2, and H3L1 (R = H) under the bromide-containing conditions of Table 1. The main article does not give numerical amounts; synthesis is listed among the Supporting Information.

reagents.name: Schiff-base ligand from o-vanillin and 2-amino-1,3-propanediol (R = H)

synthesis.time: stirred 10 min; crystals after three weeks
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: crystallized as a triclinic solvate containing two independent Cu5Dy5 clusters, nitrate, water, and methanol

properties.summary: Room-temperature χMT matches five Cu(II) and five Dy(III). χMT decreases to a minimum then rises sharply at low temperature, indicating ferromagnetic interactions. Magnetization does not saturate. Out-of-phase AC susceptibility is temperature dependent without maxima in the frequency window; a single Debye relaxation barrier was estimated by the Bartolomé method under an applied DC field.

synthesis.procedure: Obtained when only nitrate salts are used: Dy(NO3)3·6H2O and Cu(NO3)2·3H2O with H3L3, under conditions similar to complexes 1–3. No numerical amounts are given in the main text.

reagents.amount: in situ solution from 0.25 mmol of each precursor in 10.0 mL methanol

synthesis.time: ligand reflux 1 h; stirred 10 min; crystals after one week

properties.summary: High-temperature χMT is nearly constant and close to the uncoupled Cu2Dy2 value, then drops sharply below 26 K toward a nonmagnetic ground state. Magnetization isotherms are S-shaped and unsaturated, with a dM/dH maximum near 1 T at 2 K. Frequency-dependent AC maxima under an applied DC field give a small SMM barrier.

synthesis.procedure: Obtained from Dy(NO3)3·6H2O, Cu(NO3)2·3H2O, and H3L2 (R = methyl) under the nitrate-only conditions that give the butterfly series 4–6. Numerical amounts are not reported in the main text.

reagents.name: 2-methyl Schiff-base ligand from o-vanillin and a 2-amino-1,3-propanediol

synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: crystallized; isomorphous with 4, with two lattice methanol molecules

properties.summary: Polycrystalline magnetic susceptibility was measured for all six compounds, and the abstract states that all six show frequency-dependent out-of-phase AC signals indicative of SMM behavior. Separate χMT values and relaxation parameters are not reported for 5; the butterfly magnetism is discussed for representative complex 4.

synthesis.procedure: Obtained from Dy(NO3)3·6H2O, Cu(NO3)2·3H2O, and H3L1 (R = H) under the nitrate-only conditions of the butterfly series. Numerical amounts are not reported in the main text.
